thesis: Positive FCF, net income, and reported yield contrast with price near its 52-week low and below both moving averages. The single snapshot has no period comparison and recent company news is stale, so neither side dominates.

invalidation_conditions: A sustained close above SMA-50 alongside a later filing that maintains positive FCF would weaken the bear case; a new low under MYR 2.58 would weaken the bull case.
